modelingNotes: OSM part plans supply the wall core (way/227483586), eight column/plinth locations, stepped main cornice outline (way/227483585), the attic and upper central socle. The mapped heading and 18.0 m exported maximum are retained.

Commons references/00.jpg, 03.jpg and 05.jpg supply the Corinthian capitals, pink shafts, layered entablature, three main-face arches, side arch, framed reliefs, soldier statues, coffered main vault and four-horse rooftop group. The dark historic reference/01.jpg is not used for proportions.

The Louvre catalogue, https://collections.louvre.fr/ark:/53355/cl010091984, identifies a soldier statue from the Carrousel; the eight statues above the eight columns are represented as abstract original masses, as are the relief groups and rooftop allegories.

Inferred from the reviewed front view on the mapped plan and height: main opening 4.6 m wide with crown 9.45 m, secondary openings 2.3 m wide with crown 5.35 m, transverse passage 2.3 m wide with crown 5.2 m. These are five real through openings; none use dark facade panels.

The lower entablature follows mapped 10.5, 11, 11.5 and 12 m levels. The attic top/cornice is lowered to 14.6-14.9 m and the mapped upper part becomes a central double socle to 15.5 m. This inferred redistribution makes room for the source-backed horse proportions while retaining the existing 18 m total. Louvre horse catalogue https://collections.louvre.fr/ark:/53355/cl010089218 documents 2.5 m height and 2.8 m length; the original abstract masses use approximately 2.2 m height and 2.7 m length.

Shafts use shared terracotta to suggest pink marble; bronze horses use shared patina and the allegories use shared invalides-gold. Louvre https://presse.louvre.fr/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/3eba19092d807f4f71eed37ba04c4585.pdf confirms four horses, two gilded figures and a driver. Reliefs, garlands, wings and horse bodies are deliberately original abstract geometry; inscriptions and individual carving are omitted. Low LOD retains the five open passages, eight columns/statues and four-horse silhouette.
